subject: Discovery recap — Redwood Dedicated for Orion Telemetry
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@orion-telemetry.com>, Ben Park <ben.park@orion-telemetry.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Mar 2026 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap — Redwood Dedicated for Orion Telemetry

Hi Alice / Ben,

Thanks for the time today — good conversation. Quick recap from our discovery call and proposed next steps to confirm we're aligned on fit for Redwood Dedicated (reserved GPU pools). If anything below is off, flag it and I'll update.

Summary of pain points
- Unpredictable latency and tail spikes during batch jobs and live inferences (impacts SLA to your customers).
- Rising inference unit costs and high variance month over month.
- Need for data isolation and strict access controls for telemetry/PII-derived features (SOC 2 + contractual clauses).

Current stack
- Inference hosted on GCP Managed VMs running an in-house serving layer + some off-the-shelf weights.
- Models: 3 variants (encoder-only embedding model ~2B, 7B generative model for prompts, internal reranker).
- Typical traffic: avg ~20 TPS, peak bursts up to ~120 TPS for short windows; avg sequence length ~256 tokens, peak ~1024.

Success criteria for Dedicated fit
- Predictable throughput (we heard target sustained TPS ~80 for core traffic, with ability to absorb 120 TPS bursts).
- P95 latency <= 150ms for generation paths under typical load.
- Full tenant isolation (dedicated GPU pools, VPC peering option) and SOC 2 evidence for procurement.
- Onboarding timeline: goal to be production-ready within ~4–6 weeks if we proceed with a POC.

Suggested next steps
1) I'll follow up with a Dedicated proposal + pricing estimate (attached).
2) Can you share: sample 24h traffic profile (timestamps + TPS), current model sizes / offload characteristics, and any sequence-length distribution? These will help us tune kernel selection and autoscaling.
3) Technical deep-dive with your infra team (Ben + infra engineer) — propose Tue 31 Mar, 10am PT.
4) We will provide SOC 2 and security checklist; please confirm any additional compliance artifacts needed.

Attachments: redwood-dedicated-brochure.pdf (high-level), dedicated-pricing-estimate-ORN-2345.xlsx (initial estimate)

Thanks — looping in Marissa (pricing lead) and Vanessa (customer success) to help with timelines and POC scope.

Best,

Rafael Mendes

Subject: Re: Discovery recap — Redwood Dedicated for Orion Telemetry

Hi Rafael — thanks for the clear recap. This matches our notes and is helpful. A few clarifications and items from our side:

- Confirmed pain points: latency variance and cost predictability are the top two. Isolation is required for a pilot because we process customer telemetry that can be sensitive.
- Traffic: we can export a 7-day sample of TPS and seq length distribution — we'll get that to you by end of day Friday.
- Models: the 7B generative model is the main cost driver; embeddings are used for search (low qps but high token volume).
- Procurement questions: do you have reference customers in financial/telemetry spaces for Dedicated? Also curious about minimum contract length and onboarding support — we prefer a short-term POC (6–8 weeks) before any long-term commit.

We can do the technical deep-dive on Tue 31 Mar 10am PT — Ben and I will be on the call, and I'll invite our infra lead, Priya.

Thanks,
Alice
Head of Platform | Orion Telemetry
alice.chen@orion-telemetry.com

Appreciate the quick reply, Alice. A few notes in response:

- References: we'll share two recent Dedicated customers in adjacent telemetry/observability spaces (anonymized case studies attached in follow-up).
- Contract / POC: we typically do a 6–8 week POC on Dedicated with a short-term reserved commitment for the pilot. After success, customers convert to a monthly/annual reserved capacity contract (flexible terms). I'll have Marissa share a sample MPA and short-term pricing options.
- Onboarding: CS will lead the POC (Vanessa) — typical timeline 4–6 weeks with a small engineering integration (prefix-caching, autoscaling policy tuning).

Action items for Orion: share the 7-day traffic export + model artifact list (names/sizes).
Action items for Redwood: Marissa to send sample terms and pricing; Vanessa to prep POC scope and customer success plan.

Link to SOC 2 report (public): https://redwood.com/security/SOC2-report-2025.pdf

I'll attach the initial pricing estimate to this thread (dedicated-pricing-estimate-ORN-2345.xlsx).

Speak soon — see you on Tue 31 Mar 10am PT.

Best,
Rafael
